{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Texas cuisine|Texas cuisine]]

'''Frito pie''' is a corn chip and [[Cookbook:Chili con carne|chili con carne]] dish popular in the United States. Frito pie may be made with just corn chips, chili, and [[Cookbook:Cheese|shredded cheese]], but often has other condiments added as well. [[Cookbook:Sour_cream|Sour cream]], [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeños]], [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], hot sauce, [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], and various other [[Cookbook:South American cuisines|Latin American]] ingredients are often used.

This is a traditional, and basic, recipe for Frito pie. Minor variants are common.

== Ingredients ==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (710 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) Fritos corn [[Cookbook:Chip|chips]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 2 cups (590 ml) [[Cookbook:Chili (dish)|chili]] (homemade or canned)

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350 °F (175 °C).  
# Spread 2 cups of Fritos in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
# Sprinkle half of the cheese over the Fritos.
# Spread the chili over the Fritos.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes until cheese is bubbly.
# Add remaining cheese and Fritos to top of pie.
# Serve hot.
